title: Everyday Phrases — Getting a Vaccine
title_quote: I should get my vaccine soon.
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】💉 實用打疫苗必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Getting a Vaccine
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用打疫苗情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從線上用App預約時段、問是哪種疫苗要打幾針、該帶護照身份證和舊紀錄、空腹還是先吃早餐、小孩要不要家長簽名，到到診所櫃台報到排隊、填表寫過敏史、發燒能不能打、捲袖子露出上臂、護理師擦酒精消毒，再到放鬆別繃緊、針一下就好、會暈血找人陪、坐著觀察三十分鐘、詢問副作用和腫痛發燒怎麼處理，最後回家手臂痠用冰袋冰敷、別喝酒別劇烈運動、第二天低燒正常、設鬧鐘提醒第二針、收到接種紀錄的截圖存檔，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Getting a Vaccine phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering booking a slot in the clinic app, asking which vaccine and how many shots, bringing a passport, ID and old records, whether to eat first, and a parent's signature for a child, then checking in at the desk, waiting your turn, filling in the allergy box, asking about a fever, rolling up a sleeve for the upper arm and the alcohol wipe, then relaxing the muscle, the quick pinch, bringing a friend if you faint at blood, the thirty minute wait and the side effect questions, and finally the sore arm with an ice pack at home, no alcohol or hard workouts, a mild fever the next day, the reminder for dose two and saving the screenshot of your vaccination record. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I should get my vaccine soon.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, let's book it online.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我們在線上預約吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I use the clinic app?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, their website works too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which clinic is closer to home?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The small one on Maple Street.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I can't find the booking page.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap the blue button at the top.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ðə blu ˈbʌtən æt ðə tɑp./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, it asks for my name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it just like your ID.
dialogue.zh: 照身份證上的寫法輸入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an account first?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, just use your email instead.
dialogue.zh: 不用，改填你的電子信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What date works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next Thursday looks free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only two slots are left.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the earlier one, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is nine in the morning okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That time is perfect for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app says my slot is saved.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp sɛz maɪ slɑt ɪz seɪvd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check for a confirmation message.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I got a text with a code.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt ə tɛkst wɪð ə koʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我收到一封帶代碼的簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, you'll show it there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I print anything for them?
dialogue.zh: 我需要列印什麼資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the QR code is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə kjuː ɑr koʊd ɪz ɪˈnʌf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change the time later?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but do it one day early.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt du ɪt wʌn deɪ ˈɜrli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long does the visit take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About an hour with the wait.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I have to pay today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's free for tourists.
dialogue.zh: 不用，對觀光客是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My insurance card is at home.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just bring it with you too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which vaccine do they give?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The regular flu one this month.
dialogue.zh: 這個月是一般流感疫苗。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it one shot or two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two shots, four weeks apart.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I finish both in one week?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ boʊθ ɪn wʌn wiːk?/
dialogue.zh: 我能一週內打完兩針嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you must wait between them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss the second shot?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf aɪ mɪs ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 如果我錯過第二針怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just book it when you can.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this vaccine need a booster?
dialogue.zh: 這種疫苗需要追加劑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One extra shot a year is enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈɛkstrə ʃɑt ə jɪr ɪz ɪˈnʌf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I feel sick after it?
dialogue.zh: 打完我會覺得不舒服嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe a little, for one day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do staff speak other languages?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a translator on Fridays.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are they open on weekends?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only Saturday mornings, never Sunday.
dialogue.zh: 只有週六上午開，週日休診。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they take walk-in patients?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, you need a booking first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'd rather book and skip the line.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪd ˈræðər bʊk ænd skɪp ðə laɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the app already has you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I bring with me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your passport and the booking code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a driver's license okay too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, any photo ID works.
dialogue.zh: 可以，附照片的證件都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My passport expires next month.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's still fine for the clinic.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my old shot records?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ oʊld ʃɑt ˈrɛkərdz?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要舊的接種紀錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A photo on your phone works.
dialogue.zh: 把手機裡的照片帶來就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I wear a short sleeve?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it's easier for the nurse.
dialogue.zh: 對，護理師打起來比較方便。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I bring a bottle of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ brɪŋ ə ˈbɑtəl əv ˈwɔtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, you'll want a drink there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to come early?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ten minutes before is enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I park the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a small lot behind it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take the bus there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bus twelve stops right outside.
dialogue.zh: 十二號公車就在門口停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I go upstairs to check in?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡoʊ ˌʌpˈstɛrz tu tʃɛk ɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's on the ground floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I eat before the shot?
dialogue.zh: 打疫苗前可以吃東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, eat a light normal meal.
dialogue.zh: 可以，吃清淡的一般餐點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an empty stomach?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, never go in hungry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I always feel weak when hungry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So eat breakfast, then leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drink coffee that morning?
dialogue.zh: 那天早上可以喝咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cup is fine, don't overdo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I drink more water?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, water helps you stay steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take my usual medicine?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but tell the nurse about it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt tɛl ðə nɜrs əˈbaʊt ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No alcohol the night before.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, no wine that night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my son come with me?
dialogue.zh: 我兒子可以跟我一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, kids get shots there too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a parent have to sign?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, both parents if possible.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if his father can't come?
dialogue.zh: 如果他爸爸來不了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A signed note from him works.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How old must a child be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six months or older, they said.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids need a smaller dose?
dialogue.zh: 小孩要打較小的劑量嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the nurse uses a child shot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə nɜrs ˈjuzəz ə tʃaɪld ʃɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My daughter is scared of needles.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kids handle it better than adults.
dialogue.zh: 小朋友常比大人還厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, our booking is all set.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們的預約都搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, I'll set a phone alarm.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我設個手機鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We made it to the clinic.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go check in at that desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I have a nine o'clock slot.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ, aɪ hæv ə naɪn əˈklɑk slɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May I see your passport, please?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, and my booking code.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz, ænd maɪ ˈbʊkɪŋ koʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, you are signed in.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wait in this chair?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please sit down over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The room is quite full today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, flu season is busy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the wait now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe twenty more minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They call names on a screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch for your number too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, which way to the water cooler?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, wɪtʃ weɪ tu ðə ˈwɔtər ˈkulər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall, on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to fill out this form.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tu fɪl aʊt ðɪs fɔrm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use a pen, not a pencil.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What goes in the date box?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write today's date, month first.
dialogue.zh: 寫今天日期，月份放前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my home address.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write your hotel name for now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It wants my height and weight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand on the scale over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sign at the bottom?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, sign next to the arrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The form asks about allergies.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: List every allergy you have.
dialogue.zh: 把你有的過敏都列出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am allergic to penicillin.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good that you said it early.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this vaccine have eggs?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some do, so tell the nurse.
dialogue.zh: 有些有，所以要告訴護理師。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Latex makes my skin itch.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They use gloves without latex.
dialogue.zh: 他們用不含乳膠的手套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my allergies change the shot?
dialogue.zh: 我的過敏會影響打哪種針嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, the nurse picks a safe one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi, ðə nɜrs pɪks ə seɪf wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 也許會，護理師會挑安全的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had a fever last night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell the nurse before your shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get it with a fever?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ɪt wɪð ə ˈfivər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually they wait till you're better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They took my temperature just now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Was the number normal enough?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says thirty-seven point two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's fine, you can go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arm aches a little too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fever, not the shot.
dialogue.zh: 那是發燒造成的，不是打針。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am nervous about the needle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Everyone feels that way here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I sit or stand for it?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ sɪt ɔr stænd fər ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 打的時候要坐著還是站著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down, it's safer that way.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wants me to roll my sleeve.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɑnts mi tu roʊl maɪ sliːv./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, up past your shoulder.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the upper arm is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ði ˈʌpər ɑrm ɪz bɛst./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you need to take your jacket off?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju nid tu teɪk jʊr ˈdʒækɪt ɔf?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, a light shirt is fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, keep your jacket on then.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which arm should I use?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your left if you're right-handed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I don't like this cold room.
dialogue.zh: 我不喜歡這個冷冷的房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Relax, it only takes a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The nurse is washing her hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She seems calm and gentle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now she cleans my skin.
dialogue.zh: 現在她在幫我清潔皮膚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That feels cold and wet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that an alcohol wipe?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it keeps everything clean.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's counting to ten now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it dry before the needle.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does she tap my arm?
dialogue.zh: 她為什麼在拍我的手臂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She's finding a good spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the needle big today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's thinner than you think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they change needles each time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Always, it's brand new for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She shows me the sealed pack.
dialogue.zh: 她讓我看看密封的包裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it's never been used.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I look away from the tray.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the window instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's putting on fresh gloves.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One more breath and it's done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring my bag in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ brɪŋ maɪ bæɡ ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把包包帶進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it on that low table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope I catch her question.
dialogue.zh: 我希望聽得懂她的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just answer in plain words.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asks about my last vaccine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you know the exact date?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I think it was two years ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ θɪŋk ɪt wʌz tu jɪrz əˈɡoʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show her your record photo.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She wrote it down correctly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now wait for the next step.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the doctor coming to see me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈdɑktər ˈkʌmɪŋ tu si mi?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, nurses give shots here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are shaking a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them flat on your knees.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's holding a tiny vial.
dialogue.zh: 她手裡拿著一個小藥瓶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the vaccine, ready now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm sitting right beside her chair.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe out slow when she starts.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The chair tilts back a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay still, don't move yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't tense your muscle now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm trying to stay loose.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let your arm hang down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? It feels strange.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A relaxed arm hurts much less.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll go soft with it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Breathe in through your nose.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In, and out very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look at my eyes, not it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count backward from ten with me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready? The needle is quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Really, just one small pinch.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, it's already over!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did it, that was quick.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I barely felt a thing.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? No big deal at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She puts a cotton ball here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it for one full minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now a small bandage on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leave it on for a few hours.
dialogue.phonetic: /liv ɪt ɑn fər ə fju ˈaʊərz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She said I did great today.
dialogue.zh: 她說我今天表現得很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You were, you stayed so calm.
dialogue.zh: 你確實勇敢，一直那麼鎮定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arm aches just a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's totally normal after it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a bit dizzy now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay seated, don't stand yet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I felt dizzy after the last one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɛlt ˈdɪzi ˈæftər ðə læst wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's why they keep you seated.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then never come alone for shots.
dialogue.zh: 那打針別自己一個人來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My friend waited outside for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell the nurse before the needle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She can do it while you lie down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn du ɪt waɪl ju laɪ daʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It helps to look away.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And talk to someone nearby.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fainting is rare, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting first makes it safer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we wait thirty minutes.
dialogue.zh: 現在我們要觀察三十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why so long after one shot?
dialogue.zh: 為什麼一針要等這麼久？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They watch for a bad reaction.
dialogue.zh: 他們要看有沒有壞反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most people just sit and scroll.
dialogue.zh: 多數人只是坐著滑手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which chairs should we take?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those chairs near the nurse desk.
dialogue.zh: 靠近護理台的那幾張椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't leave before the timer ends.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, it's a safety rule.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I buy water while waiting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a machine down the hall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My battery is running low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the desk for a charger.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell us about any rash.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My skin feels fine so far.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What signs should I watch for?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trouble breathing is the big one.
dialogue.zh: 呼吸困難是最重要的那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is a fever a normal sign?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A low one can happen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sore arm means it is working.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə sɔr ɑrm minz ɪt ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 手臂痠代表疫苗在起作用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So a little pain is good?
dialogue.zh: 所以有點痛反而是好事？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swelling is common for two days.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I rub the spot?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, rubbing makes it worse.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, hands off the arm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I drive right after this?
dialogue.zh: 打完我可以直接開車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait till you feel steady first.
dialogue.zh: 先等你覺得穩定了再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I rest today, then?
dialogue.zh: 那我今天該好好休息嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Some people rest the whole day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do kids sleep more after shots?
dialogue.zh: 小孩打完會比較愛睡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and they may cry a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ænd ðeɪ meɪ kraɪ ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my daughter eat right away?
dialogue.zh: 我女兒可以馬上吃東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a snack helps her feel better.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə snæk hɛlps hɜr fil ˈbɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 可以，吃點點心她會舒服些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does the card say?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It lists your vaccine and date.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this paper really important?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, you'll need it later.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thirty minutes are almost up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel fine, nothing strange.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得沒事，沒有怪感覺。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She checks my face and arms.
dialogue.zh: 她看了看我的臉和手臂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then she says we can go.
dialogue.zh: 然後說我們可以離開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I ask about the second shot?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɑt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, book it before you leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They say four weeks from today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll put it in my calendar.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I take a shower tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but don't scrub the spot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is swimming okay this weekend?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better wait two days for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my arm gets hot?
dialogue.zh: 如果我的手臂發燙怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call the number on your card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that hotline open at night?
dialogue.zh: 那專線晚上也有人接嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, someone answers any time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was the side effect bad for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌz ðə saɪd ɪˈfɛkt bæd fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 對你來說副作用嚴重嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just sleepy, nothing else really.
dialogue.zh: 只是很想睡，其他都沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My throat feels a little scratchy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drink warm water and rest.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I take fever medicine now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you feel really bad.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The clinic gave me a leaflet.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it tonight, it's all there.
dialogue.zh: 今晚讀一下，重點都在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still feel strong and okay.
dialogue.zh: 我還是覺得有力氣，沒事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that's the best result.
dialogue.zh: 很好，這就是最好的結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to go, we're all done.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's thank the nurse on the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts θæŋk ðə nɜrs ɑn ðə weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 路上跟護理師說聲謝謝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We are home at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit down and rest your arm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ache is stronger tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get an ice pack for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I put ice on my arm?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ pʊt aɪs ɑn maɪ ɑrm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fifteen minutes at a time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrap the ice in a towel.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never put it on bare skin.
dialogue.zh: 千萬別直接放在皮膚上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This feels much better already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do it again in two hours.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My arm feels so heavy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't lift anything today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I sleep on that side?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better sleep on your back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sports at the gym tonight.
dialogue.zh: 今晚不要去健身房運動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, no heavy workout either.
dialogue.zh: 對，也不要做大重量訓練。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I go running tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take two easy days first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No drink for the next day.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not? I only like one beer.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt? aɪ ˈoʊnli laɪk wʌn bɪr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alcohol can hide a fever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, I'll have juice.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I cook dinner tonight?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but nothing that takes long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you drink a lot of water?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju drɪŋk ə lɑt əv ˈwɔtər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three bottles, and one big tea.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll sleep early tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest helps the vaccine work.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I feel tomorrow morning?
dialogue.zh: 明天早上我會感覺如何？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Probably sore, but still okay.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Woke up with a low fever.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's common on the next day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My body feels warm and tired.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stay in bed and drink more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The thermometer says thirty-eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's mild, watch it till noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I cancel my meeting?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you feel really weak.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By evening my fever went down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, that means you're fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did your arm swell again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little, but it's going away.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days until it stops?
dialogue.zh: 還要幾天才會完全不痠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two or three, then it's gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call if it lasts much longer.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll use the clinic number.
dialogue.zh: 好，我會打診所那支電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My head hurts a little too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That can come from the shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel like I'm catching something.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the vaccine, not a cold.
dialogue.zh: 那是疫苗反應，不是感冒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I go to work tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if the fever is gone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My energy came back by noon.
dialogue.zh: 到中午我的體力就回來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then go out for a short walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɡoʊ aʊt fər ə ʃɔrt wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 那就出門散個短距離的步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Don't forget the second shot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I set two alarms on my phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ sɛt tu əˈlɑrmz ɑn maɪ foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 我在手機設了兩個鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app sent a reminder text.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine says the tenth of next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn sɛz ðə tɛnθ əv nɛkst mʌnθ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pick a Saturday slot?
dialogue.zh: 我可以選週六的時段嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Saturday mornings are open.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I go to the same clinic?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ ɡoʊ tu ðə seɪm ˈklɪnɪk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they have your record there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the second shot worse?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For some people, a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I feel tired again?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe, so rest that evening.
dialogue.zh: 也許，所以那晚早點休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My husband got his today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How did he feel after it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He said one arm felt numb.
dialogue.zh: 他說有一邊手臂麻麻的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That fades within an hour.
dialogue.zh: 那會在一個小時內消退。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did they send you a record?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a photo just arrived.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It shows the brand and date.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And your batch number too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I save this screenshot?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, put it in two folders.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll print one copy too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep one in your travel bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need it for my visa?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ɪt fər maɪ ˈvizə?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sometimes, so keep it close.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My office asked for proof.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send them that same picture.
dialogue.zh: 把同一張照片發給他們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks so official with a stamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lʊks soʊ əˈfɪʃəl wɪð ə stæmp./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clinic stamps every record.
dialogue.zh: 診所會為每份紀錄蓋章。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a message for dose two?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ fər doʊs tu?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they text one week ahead.
dialogue.zh: 會，他們提前一週發簡訊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can my husband's mom get one?
dialogue.zh: 我先生的媽媽也能打嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, older adults need it more.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she need a ride there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Please drive her next Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm glad we did this today.
dialogue.zh: 很高興我們今天做了這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, I feel safer now.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我現在安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one more shot to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we're done for the year.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the card in my passport.
dialogue.zh: 把那張卡放進我的護照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good place, no one loses it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll wear a short sleeve again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, I'll do the same.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same time in four weeks, then.
dialogue.zh: 那就四週後的同一時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now rest, and sleep well.
dialogue.zh: 現在好好休息，睡個好覺。
